title: PNC Bank "Teamwork" — 30 s brand spot
substyle: Typographic playground (proposed): illustrated characters acting inside giant 3D letters

secondary_motion: follow-through and overlapping action on limbs, pendulum swings on rings, arcs on jumps; no squash on objects or type
color: several colors throughout (teal, burgundy, orange, slate blue, olive) but muted on a cream ground
typography: the word TEAMWORK is the set: each giant letter is an obstacle-course structure; letters are not deformed or kinetic themselves
shape_language: hand-made props (wood grain, ropes, nets, trees, a deer) on geometric extruded letters; elongated stylized figures
character_humor: characters are the story: climbing, pulling each other up, high-fives, swinging, a relay toward a finish flag

signature: A slow, constant camera truck along the word TEAMWORK built as a playground, cutting letter to letter while stylized figures help each other through it, then a pull-back reveal of the whole word and the logo.

music.summary: 136 BPM with a moderate pulse (0.51) and very low percussive share (0.10); cuts and accents lean slightly toward the beat (40% / 47% vs 32% chance, only 10 cuts) and the music builds to its peak around the TEAMWORK reveal at 24 s, then decays under the logo.

family_note: 03 Character: characters acting and helping each other carry the message, like ref05. Different look from ref05 (dimensional letters, cream background, elongated figures, no section colors) and a calmer edit (continuous trucking camera, one letter per shot), so a sub-style is proposed. Typography is the environment, which links it to typographic brand films.

behaviors.mechanism: camera trucks right at a constant speed through every shot (scene content drifts left), never eased in or out
behaviors.notes: phase correlation per shot: 1.0-4.4 px/f @1920 (1-5.4% width/s), sd 0.1-0.6 px/f. Example shot f484-f573 shown; all shots fit Flat (0.010-0.029)

behaviors.mechanism: hard cut from one letter-set to the next (T, E, A, M, W, O, R, K), camera keeps the same drift direction so the move carries across the cut
after the letter-by-letter journey, a cut to a wide shot reveals the whole word TEAMWORK as one playground, with a small orange banner line above it
figures climb, pull and boost each other up structures, then celebrate together (high-five); acting built on cooperation
behaviors.notes: T shot f86-f124 (climb to top, high-five), box shot f301-f341; read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: figure swings ring to ring along a rope line; body trails the arm and legs follow through on each swing (pendulum arcs)
behaviors.notes: E shot f160-f210; rings swing after being released; read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: crouch (anticipation) then jump along an arc off a block onto a rope bridge; partner runs alongside
behaviors.notes: f313 crouch -> f327-f341 leap; read from sheet c_M_A_jump; camera drift prevents clean tracking

behaviors.mechanism: scenes never freeze: background figures keep climbing, a deer grazes, ropes sway while the camera drifts
behaviors.notes: motion 73.5% of the time; only 2 holds (the final word and the logo, ~3 s each)

behaviors.mechanism: cut to a static cream end card: PNC Bank logo with tagline and a single figure standing beside it; no logo animation
music-sync: the music builds through the letter shots and peaks around the wide TEAMWORK reveal, then decays under the logo; cuts lean slightly toward the beat
behaviors.notes: 136 BPM, pulse 0.51; cuts on beat 40% vs chance 32% (n=10), accents on beat 47%; median shot 5.1 beats
